questions.question: Fixation of a biological sample can be done by treating with
Permeabilization of fixed RBCs on a slide can be done by treating with 1% Triton X-100. What is the purpose of this step?

answers.c: To preserve the internal structure of the cells

questions.question: The procedure to make tiny holes into cells to facilitate the antibody entry is known as
Non-specific binding of primary antibody in intracellular space would be blocked by
In which step in microscopy is PPD (p-phenylenediamine) used?
During immuno-localization, cells are fixed to ______

answers.d: Wash off protein from the cells

questions.question: Before plating cells on 12 mm cover glass for study of phagocytosis, the cover glass should be

answers.a: Soaked in DMEM media without FBS
answers.d: Soaked in DMEM media with suspension of latex beads

questions.question: Why is fixation of the specimen an important step in immunolocalization?

answers.a: It enhances the specificity of primary antibodies.
answers.b: It preserves the cellular structure and prevents degradation of proteins.
answers.c: It amplifies the signal from secondary antibodies.
answers.d: It is not necessary in immunolocalization protocols.

questions.question: In the immunolocalization protocol, what do primary antibodies specifically bind to?
What is the purpose of blocking in an immunolocalization protocol?

answers.a: To permanently attach the specimen to the slide
answers.b: To prevent non-specific binding of antibodies
answers.d: To amplify the signal from primary antibodies
